title: Striker 96
overview:
Have you got the goal-scoring genius? The play-making midfield prowess? The never-say-die defense? Prove it all in Striker 96!

Go for the grass-stained glory in the open stadium with variable field and weather conditions or take on the speed-king, rebounding goalfest of 6-on-6 indoor soccer!

Crowd chants! Diving headers! Sliding tackles! Bicycle kicks! Nerve-racking shootouts! Goals! Goals! Gooooaaaaals!

The #1 Team Sport in the World Comes Alive!
